# Corporate Procurement & Vendor Policy

## Section 1: Purchase Order & Approval Thresholds

1.1 Capital and software expenditures above PO-5000 ($5,000) require a pre-approved purchase order under control PROC-101, and commitments above PO-25000 ($25,000) require three competitive vendor bids, except for pre-negotiated sole-source master agreements approved by Legal.

## Section 2: Vendor Security & Due Diligence

2.1 Before onboarding any SaaS or cloud supplier handling internal company data, Procurement MUST verify current SOC2-II attestation and security sign-off under PROC-204 (aligned with SEC-REV-30), provided that annual penetration summaries are uploaded before PO issuance.

## Section 3: Software & Cloud Subscription Renewals

3.1 Auto-renewing enterprise subscriptions exceeding $10,000 annually MUST undergo ROI review at least 30 days ahead of renewal under rule SAAS-AUTO-30, unless Finance Procurement logs a multi-year rate lock justification.

## Section 4: Emergency Outage Procurement

4.1 During an active SEV-1 outage declared under playbook IR-RB-012, engineering directors may execute emergency cloud capacity purchases up to $15,000 via fast-track EMERG-PO-09, subject to CFO ratification within 5 business days.

## Section 5: Conflict of Interest & Gift Restrictions

5.1 Employees participating in vendor evaluation MUST disclose any personal financial interest and observe the $50 annual gift limit under COI-50; staff are not entitled to accept equity, advisory retainers, or referral fees from candidate vendors.
